title: Sarah's Passing | Beyond the Story: Chayei Sarah (Ep. 5)
blurb: The Zohar identifies Avraham with the soul and Sarah with the body. Why, then, does Hashem tell Avraham to listen to Sarah? Isn’t the soul supposed to guide the body? In this episode of BEYOND the STORY, Rabbi Shais Taub explores what Avraham’s mourning for Sarah reveals about the relationship between body and soul. Through the teachings of Chassidus, we discover why the soul needs the body, what feminine spirituality teaches us about serving Hashem, and why ordinary physical life is central to our purpose. title: Chapter 37.03: Transforming Man and the World
blurb: Chapter 37.03: Transforming Man and the World The Tanya Applied radio show is broadcast every Saturday night, 10–10:30PM ET on WSNR 620 AM – Metro NY area WJPR 1640 AM — Highland Park and Edison, NJ Online: www.talklinenetwork.com By phone: Listen Line: 641-741-0389 Many of us may be familiar with some of the central ideas in Tanya – including the battle of the two souls; what defines man and makes us tick; how we can control our temptations; how we can become more loving; what we can do to curb and harness our vices, like anger, jealousy, and depression; the formula for growth; how we can develop a healthy relationship with G-d; and why we are here. In this 30-minute program, you will learn how these ideas can be applied to your life today. You will discover secrets to a successful life that will transform you and your relationships. Rabbi Simon Jacobson is the best-selling author of Toward a Meaningful Life, and he is the creator of the acclaimed and popular MyLife: Chassidus Applied series, which has empowered and transformed hundreds of thousands through Torah and Chassidus. Now, Rabbi Jacobson brings his vast scholarship and years of experience to Tanya. Please join Rabbi Simon Jacobson for this exhilarating journey into your psyche and soul. You will come away with life-changing practical guidance and direction, addressing all the issues and challenges you face in life. title: I Made the Mistake of Misrepresenting the Rebbe
blurb: When a group of Jewish students barricaded themselves in a shelter and threatened mass suicide, R' Dovid Eliezrie was called upon to intervene. But a startling phone call from the Rebbe’s mazkirus taught him a lesson he won't forget.
